items.title: Trump unveils $17 billion of Southeast Asia deals for US firms, White House says
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 19 () - US President Donald Trump announced more than $17 billion in commercial deals and strategic investments for US ‌companies in Southeast Asia, following a two-day working visit to the ‌Philippines for the ASEAN Summit, the White House said.1130 ringgit) (Reporting ‌by Rozanna Latiff in Kuala Lumpur, Karen Lema in Manila, ​Orathai Sriring in Bangkok, and Fransiska Nangoy in Jakarta; Writing by ​Rozanna Latiff; Editing by David Stanway).

items.title: Of 4 Stocks With 80%+ ROE, One Investor Says Only Nvidia Fits “Buffett’s Own Criterion”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNVIDIA (NVDA) stands out among four high-ROE stocks because its historical returns came largely from operating profitability rather than financial leverage. Home Depot (HD) also generated an ROE above 80%, but its debt increased by nearly $20 billion between fiscal 2021 and fiscal 2025.
